result:
Both pass. Here's what changed:

- **`lib/tasks.ts`**: Updated the guard from `> 120` to `> 200` and the error message to `1..200`.
- **`db/migrations/003_increase_title_max_length.sql`**: New migration that rebuilds the `tasks` table with the updated `check (length(title) between 1 and 200)` constraint (SQLite doesn't support altering CHECK constraints in place).
- **`lib/tasks.test.ts`**: Added two tests — one verifying a 200-char title is accepted, one verifying 201 chars is rejected.

Rollback note for the PR: SQLite has no automatic down-migration. To reverse, run the same table-rebuild pattern restoring `check (length(title) between 1 and 120)` — any existing rows with titles 121–200 chars would need to be truncated or deleted first.
